# RenderTargetScope

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Graphics` · struct

```csharp
public readonly struct RenderTargetScope : IDisposable
```

Goes back to the render target that was in use when disposed, and for a batch's target, to how the batch was drawing to it. See [`GraphicsService.UseRenderTarget`](GraphicsService.md#userendertarget) and [`SpriteBatch.UseRenderTarget`](SpriteBatch.md#userendertarget).

## Methods

### Dispose

```csharp
public void Dispose()
```

Goes back to the target before this one.
